text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Today, once again, I—dive.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Without fear, dive deep. Keep on running.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(My job. Trainer's job.
Feeling both of them with these legs of mine.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(—Just like that mock race.
Flawlessly. Steadfastly.
Constructing it. Accomplishing it.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Just as the ideal job should be!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Believe makes her move! Believe surges ahead!!
Believe takes the lead!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!!
First place is Believe, it's Believe!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Queen of Autumn Sprints reigns magnificently!!
Are there any foes left to challenge her in the sprint division?!
Believe stands at the pinnacle of speedsters!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Whew............
Alright.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —It's a dream job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I took first place in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
Thank you so much, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Good work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I answer with genuine excitement.
I simply couldn't help it—Believe's run today was that magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt it strongly during the mock race the other day too—the running style she's polished since her debut has now reached its absolute ideal form...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to this point,
she is no longer just an artisan, butâ"
choice_data_list: You're already in the realm of a master
You've already reached the level of a "master artisan."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ……Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...no. Well, um.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That's too fast. Surely not that quickly.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It's... still too early. I—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The same title as Grandpa...? No way.
I'm still not ready for that...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I-It's way too fast, for sure...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While I feel like I've witnessed yet another side of you...
for now, let's leave it at that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen ended
with the best possible result.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With things as they are, the next logical step is to aim
for consecutive victories in the autumn sprint festival, the Sprinters Stakes."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, let's run a tune-up race in the Centaur Stakes
and head in at peak condition...
That was what Believe and I decided."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Now then, that night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As for me, even after returning to my room,
I kept replaying Believe's run from today
over and over in my head.
choice_data_list: Man, we really ran a great race...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was certain this was the finished form.
This was the true essence. The absolute pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That this was the pinnacle of running that both I and Believe had strived to reach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, at that very moment... Believe's running had reached such a state of perfection.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It had ended up... finished.
